latestVersion.changelog:
CAD Agent 1.0.0: Initial release – AI agents can visually iterate on 3D CAD models via a rendering server.

- Provides HTTP endpoints for model creation, modification, multi-view/image rendering, export, and printability analysis
- All CAD logic and rendering handled securely inside the container; agents use only build123d code and view images
- Supports iterated visual workflow: send modeling commands, see results as images, modify as needed
- Export models in common formats (STL, STEP, 3MF); design safety tools prevent accidental versioning of outputs
- Full setup and usage instructions included for Docker and docker-compose environments
